title: Roadmap review + canonical roadmap <-> work-queue <-> architecture loop (manager skill + CLAUDE.md)
note: [2026-10-11T09:40Z operator request, close paraphrase, HIGH priority] Review the roadmap, then add to the manager skill the relationship between the roadmap and the work queue. The roadmap is for high-level planning: highly detailed, but a tool for seeing the bigger picture of where we are on the way to the system goals. Build and maintain an effective, consistent process for BUILDING and PRIORITISING the work queue FROM the roadmap, then keeping the roadmap UP TO DATE with the outcomes of work items. The architecture map (docs/ARCHITECTURE-CANONICAL.md) is part of the same loop. Done = roadmap reviewed and corrected against measured state; the loop written into .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md (+ a CLAUDE.md line) with a recurring step (e.g. in the daily review / evening review) that (a) derives/re-prioritises checklist rows from roadmap milestones, (b) writes outcomes back to the roadmap + architecture map; proven by running it once.
